name: Aether Dynamo Core
description: Compact arcane-mechanical core. Light and responsive; if disabled, the Crest falls.

name: Heavy Aether Furnace
description: High-output core expanding Wit capacity (+2), Mote storage (+1), Mote interval (-1 beat), and thermal headroom.

name: Articulated Stride Legs
description: Lightweight bipedal actuators: fast, but rated for only 70 weight before slowing.

name: Reinforced Anchor Legs
description: Heavy braced actuators rated for 150 weight, with strong displacement resistance.

name: Heavy Armor Plating
description: Adds +1 protection d6 and resists displacement at the cost of weight.

name: Inventor's Spellbook
description: Raises pilot base Wit to 10, adds +2 Mote storage, and unlocks arcane spells.

name: Righteous Blade
description: Reliable short-commitment melee blade.

name: Vorpal Edge
description: Ultra-fast melee blade enabling rapid combinations.

name: Titan Hammer
description: Mote-driven heavy melee weapon that punishes heavy Crests.

name: Talon Machine Pistol
description: Quick conventional sidearm with low telegraphing.

name: Falconet Missile Pod
description: Medium-range missile rack (6 ammo) firing committed 3-shot salvos.

name: Dragon's Breath Projector
description: Short-range thermal weapon (4 ammo) that generates Crest heat.

name: Siege Mortar
description: Long-range artillery tube firing telegraphed high-impact shells.

name: Acid Sprayer
description: Corrosive projector (6 ammo) that eats through armor plating.

name: Shield Generator
description: Passive defensive field granting +1 protection d6 while operational.

name: Repulsor Emitter
description: Reactive short-range pulse dealing 1 damage and shoving attackers away.

name: Blink Drive
description: Reactive spatial shifter enabling evasion of committed attacks.

name: Jump Jets
description: Boosts movement (+1 unit per beat) and grants Jet Dash.

name: Thermal Regulator
description: Vents excess heat (+2 per beat) and adds +2 thermal capacity.

name: Arcane Amplifier
description: Channels heavy pilot spells such as Gravity Crush through the Crest.

name: Oathsteel Plating
description: Researched armor: tougher and lighter than standard plating.

name: Stormglass Capacitor
description: Researched Mote reservoir: +1 Mote storage and Motes 1 beat faster. Helps fit Square Summon in the field.

name: Skystrider Legs
description: Researched locomotion: fast (7) and light, rated for 90 weight, but walking commits 1 Wit.

name: Cargo Rack
description: Stowage for prepared items: carries 4 cargo units of fast-iron, ammo packs, or other consumables, and lets the Crest use them mid-fight. Its contents are unusable while it is disabled.
